The Department of National Health and Welfare published this report on public health and sanitation in Canada. The committee met in Ottawa to discuss communicable disease control and vaccination. Le ministere de la sante a publie ce rapport sur la sante publique au Canada.
Page two continues the discussion of hospital funding and medical care across the provinces of Ontario and Alberta. The board reviewed the annual report and recommended new measures for disease prevention and community health.
The third page presents statistical tables compiled by Statistics Canada on mortality and morbidity. These figures were gathered from provincial health authorities and reviewed by the royal commission on health services.
